fusions.name: Strip the Blubber
fusions.desc: A biting strike that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each. It makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hidden Rows of Teeth
fusions.desc: Snaps a short cone ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 40% chance of [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Under the Hull
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, moving 15% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Opened Seam
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
